However, when he spots Vikram having trouble with his car, he doesn't back down from helping him. The two connect instantaneously. Will Suman get to know about this bond?

videos.title: A Shocker for Suman
videos.overview: Vikram visits Suman's place for dinner and has a sweet bonding session with the family. Post dinner, Vikram tells Suman about his new friend and wants Suman to meet him as well. It comes as a rude shock to Suman that Vikram's new friend is none other than her ex-boyfriend and now an enemy, Captain Shravan Malhotra. Later, Vikram rings up Shravan asking to meet. Suman gets a hint about their meeting. What will she do now? Will Vikram and Shravan meet each other again?

videos.title: Suman Decides to Come Clean
videos.overview: Shravan gets the token for his house, but is in a fix as he has to vacate his place in a week. However, he tries to be unaffected by this matter in front of Suman. Later, during a game of arm wrestling with his friends, bitter nostalgia bites Shravan as he gets reminded of his times with Suman. Simultaneously, Suman decides to uncover her past to Vikram and tell him all about Shravan. Will Suman be able to tell Vikram her true story? Will Vikram find out the shocking truth about his new friend?

videos.title: The Void in Shravan's Life
videos.overview: Shravan's troubles keep growing as his shoulder treatment takes long. He cannot wait to join his command back and wants to rid himself of Bhopal and all the painful memories associated with this place. He feels desolate as his family is fragmented, and he has no one to come back home to and bond with in real sense. Heartbroken by all that's transpired, Shravan gets into a sentimental conversation with Bunty. What will happen when Suman overhears them speaking? How will she react?

videos.title: Kanchan Votes for Vikram
videos.overview: Vikram leaves a surprise gift for Suman, but Kanchan, playfully, doesn't let her open the gift. Later, Kanchan gets stunned to see Shravan around. When she tells Suman about it, Suman tells her that she is already aware and Shravan Malhotra is now 'Captain Shravan Malhotra.' This news shocks Kanchan and she tells Suman to not focus on anyone but Vikram. Later, Kanchan helps Suman get ready for Vikram in the saree which he had gifted her. Watch ahead to know what unfolds next in this story.

videos.title: Brutal Truth Greets Shravan
videos.overview: Shravan is dragged to the Tiwari house by Veer, he sees Suman at the doorstep dressed in a saree, and is left speechless. However, he tells Suman that he is here because of Veer and leaves the place immediately. While leaving, he sees Vikram entering the Tiwari house and figures that he and Suman are a couple. Shattered and angry on learning the truth, Shravan spends some alone time. Tune into Ek Duje Ke Vaaste 2, only on Sony LIV, to see how things pan out between Shravan and Suman.

videos.title: Shravan Reveals the Truth to Vikram
videos.overview: Shravan calls up Suman in an inebriated state and tells her not to break Vikram's heart. Suman rudely tells Shravan not to do anything to make her ties sour with Vikram. Furious at Suman's thinking, Shravan meets Vikram in his chamber and breaks it to him that he is Devraj Malhotra's son, Shravan Malhotra. How will Vikram tackle this truth? Will he break his friendship with Shravan? Or will he keep his personal and professional matters separate? Tune in right away to find your answer.

videos.title: The Tiwari-Malhotra Court Case
videos.overview: Shravan and Suman, both have come to Bhopal to sort out their court matter. The growing impatience for the final verdict is visible in both the ex-lovers. However, owing to his ill-health, Devraj is unable to travel to Bhopal, which is why Shravan makes a request for another date for the hearing. Suspecting that Devraj is making an excuse to buy time to deploy his methods and win illegally, Suman puts her foot down, and declines Shravan's request. What will happen now? Watch on to know!

videos.title: Agony Strikes Suman
videos.overview: After the verdict on Tiwari-Malhotra case, Suman has sunk into the depths of sorrow, as she feels that she couldn't avail justice for her father. Though her family tries to console her, nothing seems to work. While Shravan informs his family members that Devraj has been proven innocent, his words still seem to be ringing in Suman's ears. She shares her conflicted feelings concerning Shravan with Kanchan. Will Suman's anger subside? Or will things get worse between her and Shravan?

videos.title: Veer's Birthday Celebrations
videos.overview: Suman hears great commotion happening outside the Malhotra House and assumes that Shravan is celebrating his win. To prove her point to Shravan, she decides to celebrate Veer and Vikram's birthday. Suman strongly refuses Vikram from inviting Shravan to the party. However, Suman's chachi drops in at Shravan's house along with Veer, with a hope to start afresh. She warmly invites them to Veer's birthday party. What will happen now? Will Shravan attend Veer's birthday celebrations?

videos.title: Suman’s Untold Discomfort
videos.overview: When Shravan arrives at the party, Vikram is elated as he holds Shravan in high regards and likes him as a friend. Suman, on the other hand, is shocked to see him. With each second, her discomfort rises. Then, Vikram asks Suman to dance with him. Suman obliges, and while they are dancing, she and Shravan recall the moment when they danced together. Is this a sign that fate will finally change its way for Suman and Shravan, or is this merely wishful thinking?

videos.title: Suman and Shravan's Confessions
videos.overview: Vikram completely understands Suman when she clarifies that she doesn't like to discuss her professional life. He even praises Suman. This puts Shravan at unease. Tipsy Bunty's confession that Shravan wasn't celebrating his win, makes Suman realize that she was too harsh on Shravan. Later, Suman confesses to Shravan how she felt left out in these 7 years. She then adds that she tried reaching him but couldn't. Shravan also expresses that he too was lonely without her.

videos.title: Rebellious Suman, Angry Shravan
videos.overview: Shravan is practicing in the shooting range, but is unable to focus. Suman's presence and his injury hinder him. Suman helps him focus on his target. Later, Shravan gets to know that Suman has decided to take the Tiwari-Malhotra case to a higher court. This enrages Shravan. Meanwhile, Suman also learns that her chachi is trying to sell the house. She vows to do anything she can to stop the house from being sold.

videos.title: Shravan's Painful Decision
videos.overview: Vikram meets Shravan and says that he has no qualms even if Shravan and Suman were once together. Vikram tells him that Suman cleared the matter and told him that it was nothing beyond an adolescent mistake. Hearing this, Shravan feels shattered. He discusses with Bunty how everyone has moved on in life, except him. He then decides to give Suman a taste of her own medicine. What plan is brewing in Shravan's mind?

videos.title: Paying Guest Shravan?
videos.overview: Veer falls sick and starts throwing a fit about wanting to see Shravan. Beena requests Shravan to come over to spend time with Veer. While Suman gets uncomfortable about Shravan's presence, Veer feels happy to have a friend around. Shravan spends the night at Tiwari House. The next day, Beena pitches the thought that Shravan can stay as a paying guest at their house. Will Shravan take up this offer? How will Suman react to her chachi's proposal? Tune in to know.

videos.title: Envious Suman?
videos.overview: Suman is infuriated about Shravan's decision to stay as a paying guest at Tiwari House. When Shravan goes back home to pack his luggage, he meets Sophie, who is a wedding planner. Shravan and Sophie get chatting and begin to bond instantly. Sophie helps Shravan to shift his luggage to Suman's house. How will Suman deal with this new entrant in Shravan's life? Will sparks of jealousy fly or will Suman be indifferent to their friendship?

videos.title: Suman's Evident Discomfort
videos.overview: Shravan and Sophie have a pleasant time in each other's company. Shravan's stories make Sophie laugh and keep her engaged. Suman clearly doesn't appreciate Sophie's closeness to Shravan. The next morning, Suman tells Shravan that since he is staying at the Tiwari House as a paying guest, he has to abide by their rules and pay for the food as well. Shravan accepts all her terms and conditions, but also puts forth his own. It further complicates the situation between these two.

videos.title: Sophie's Secret
videos.overview: While leaving to attend some important work, Vikram requests Shravan to drop Suman home. In the car, to make Suman jealous, Shravan deliberately compliments Sophie's sense of humour. Later, he calls Sophie over for dinner, but Sophie refuses and reveals that she and Vikram were once a couple. She requests Shravan not to tell Suman about this. Will Shravan comply?

videos.title: Suman's Emotional Breakdown
videos.overview: Shravan is concerned about Suman as she is having a major emotional breakdown. She writes in her diary about the inability of the others to understand her. Shravan fabricates a lie and tells Suman that his shoulder injury is giving him a hard time. He does all this just to see her mood, but Suman briskly gives him a painkiller and sends him off.  This increases Shravan's concern. What will he do now?

videos.title: Extracting the Truth From Shravan
videos.overview: Suman is miffed about Vikram ghosting her at the dinner. After hearing Shravan's perspective, Vikram decides to apologize to Suman for letting her down. Vikram drops in at the Tiwari House to clear things up with Suman. Though Suman accepts the apology, she has a hunch that Shravan had something to do with all this. When she spots Shravan sitting alone in the lawn, she walks up to him and questions him to find out if he and Vikram had a word. Tune in to know what Shravan tells Suman.

videos.title: Still Into Each Other, Shravan-Suman?
videos.overview: While playing chess with Veer, Shravan recollects his good times with daddu. Later, at dinner, the food reminds Shravan of his mom and the lovely time his family spent together. Torn apart by all that has happened in the past, Suman feels sorry looking at Shravan's state. The next morning, Suman waits for Shravan while leaving for cant. Does Suman still have feelings for Shravan? Are both of them still drawn to each other?

videos.title: Shravan-Suman's Unresolved Feelings
videos.overview: Even though they separated aeons ago, Shravan and Suman can't stop thinking about each other.  Both feel an unexplained urgency to see each other without any apparent reason. They realise that this is wrong. They can't let this happen and their hearts must accept this truth. He calls Suman and asks her to meet him so that this can be resolved forever. To his shock, Suman agrees to meet him. But will their meeting go as expected?

videos.title: Shravan's Ingenious Plan
videos.overview: When the Tewari family leaves to visit a relative, Shravan, Sophie, Suman, and Vikram plan an outing. Shravan and Suman readily agree to join so as to show each other that they have moved on. However, at the very last minute, Vikram has to retire from the plan as he has an important meeting in Delhi, which he can't miss. Therefore, Suman also steps out from the plan. So, Shravan devises a plan to coerce Suman into joining the outing so that he can make her jealous. What is brewing in his mind?

videos.title: Suman’s Embarrassment
videos.overview: The longing and heartache only seem to grow deeper for our couple of Shakespearean tragedy, Shravan and Suman. So, after the night party when Shravan sees Vikram unsuccessfully trying to kiss Suman, he has a heartache, while Suman also feels embarrassed. Following morning, when Suman tries to initiate a conversation, Shravan talks rudely to her. He also laughs at her, which hurts Suman deeply, and she leaves in anger and disappointment. Is this incident the end of their love?

videos.title: Avni's Return to Bhopal
videos.overview: As the rift between Shravan and Suman continues to widen, Shravan's sister, Avni, returns to the fabulous city of Bhopal. While Shravan tries to hide his recent updates from Avni, his special friendship with Sophie kind of gives it all away. Check out what happens when Avni learns about the entire Malhotra-Tiwari situation, in this episode. Tune in now!

videos.title: Suman Outshines Shravan
videos.overview: After Shravan dances with Sophie, Suman cannot control her jealousy and goes ahead to dance her heart out with Vikram. Infact, Suman and Vikram's dance turns out to be better than Shravan's. Is this merely jealousy or some lingering affection from the past? Vikram starts to think seriously about his relationship with Suman. Watch ahead to know where the story leads to.

videos.title: Shravan-Suman, Made for Another?
videos.overview: The wound on Shravan's arm has healed completely and he is advised to resume duty. Suman is not able to get over Shravan talking about his death in such a casual manner, which she tries to talk to him about but he leaves before she's finished. Parallely, Suman's mother announces that the date of her engagement with Vikram is soon to be fixed. This news shocks Suman and Shravan, both equally. How will they react to this sudden development?

videos.title: Match for Shravan
videos.overview: Shravan's dad asks him to check his whatsapp which contains a message from his mom. She has sent photographs of a few girls and asks him to choose the one he likes as his life partner. Veer tells this to everyone in the house and a discussion follows around this topic, leaving Suman and Shravan in an awkward jitter. Find out what's next in this episode.

videos.title: What's Cooking in Shravan's Life?
videos.overview: Avni is bold enough to ask Sophie directly about her feelings for Shravan. Sophie confides that Shravan does feel for her. However, the very next moment, Avni sees Shravan's care for Suman and starts doubting Sophie's claims. Meanwhile, Suman's engagement preparations are on, but she seems very nonchalant about the same. Avni and Bunty feel that they should somehow make Shravan realize about his true feelings. Does Shravan still have a thing for Suman?

videos.title: Suman Wants to Slow Down
videos.overview: All of the Tiwari family gets a gift each from Ramesh Chachu, but Suman gets a special one. A necklace, as part of the Kanyadaan that her Chachu is responsible for, gets Beena Chachi upset for it seems a bit too expensive. Later, when Vikram excitedly plans for their wedding, from designs to dates, Suman requests him about wanting more till she figures out some responsibilities for her family. Will Vikram support her situation?

videos.title: Suman's Secret Diary
videos.overview: Although Suman's wedding date is nearing, Shravan finds it impossible to throw her out of his heart. So, one night while Suman is talking on the phone, he goes to her room and sees her personal diary. It brings back memories. Later, Suman injures herself over a nail. Seeing her in pain, tears Shravan from the inside. With a promise to never allow any harm to come to Suman, Shravan confronts her and speaks his heart out. Will this confrontation bend the tide, or will it be all for naught?

videos.title: Sophie, Heartbroken on Diwali Day
videos.overview: The Tiwaris prepare themselves for the Laxmi Pooja day with utmost joy and happiness. While they celebrate the evening, Sophie arrives with a surprise, inviting the family for a Diwali dinner at her place. Suman notices Shravan trying too hard to keep his spirits up. To Sophie's approaches, he reacts confusedly, as he can't get his mind off Suman. Will Shravan come clean to Sophie? Will Sophie be heartbroken?

videos.title: Shravan Can't Get Over Suman
videos.overview: Shravan, in spite of all the glitz and glamour of the Diwali party, is lost in his own world. A world which takes him back to the good old days, when he and Suman were best of pals and so much in love with each other. Suman notices his aloofness in the party and decides to find out the reason behind this. Watch what unfolds between them, in this episode.

videos.title: SuVan, a Connection for Lifetime
videos.overview: Shravan and Suman, without informing Sophie and Vikram, reach the cantonment to celebrate Diwali with their friends. Both of them try to say something to each other, but everytime they get disturbed. At the campfire, the couple feels for each other's families when their Superiors ask them to share their yesteryear Diwali experiences. Later, a phone call from Shravan's CO ruins their entire evening.

videos.title: Suman's Unspoken Words
videos.overview: Suman paces up and down in her room and her head is filled with Shravan's thoughts. She wonders what his real dream is. To calm her nerves, she resorts to writing her diary. She wonders about the strange feeling that she is going through. Is it due to Shravan's departure or is it because she fails to convey her message to him? Stay tuned to this episode to find out.

videos.title: Suman-Shravan, Remnants of Love
videos.overview: Disheartened by Shravan's sudden departure, Veer misses his company. The Tiwaris have this conversation at the breakfast table, where Chachi tries to ask Suman if she has any clue about why Shravan left. While this topic spoils Suman's mood to the core, Shravan shows up at the Tiwari house leaving everyone surprised. As soon as Shravan sits for breakfast, Suman confronts him about not answering her calls, leaving him confused about her real concerns. Does Suman's worry mean something more?

videos.title: Sophie Confronts Shravan
videos.overview: Love is a spectrum of broad emotions. On one hand, it emits compassion whereas on the other, it causes heartache. In the same way, where Suman and Shravan show that they both still care deeply for each other by doing little yet profound things for each other, Sophie is heartbroken, as Shravan is in love with this mysterious girl. So, she takes Shravan into seclusion and insists him to reveal who the girl is. Shravan is in a dilemma. Will he tell the truth?

videos.title: Shravan Hasn't Moved On
videos.overview: Although Suman insists on pursuing the case against Shravan, Vikram somehow finds it hard to believe. He can't help but think that Suman still has feelings for Shravan. Meanwhile, in a heart-to-heart chat with Bunty, Shravan confesses that he has not changed a bit with respect to his feelings for Suman, which till date are very much strong. Will Shravan try to win over Suman, one more time? Stay tuned to this episode to find out.

videos.title: Suman Ke Dil Ki Baat
videos.overview: Suman tries to steal a chance to talk to Shravan, but doesn't succeed. While she waits for him to get back, she falls asleep during penning down her feelings for him. Shravan, who could never wipe out Suman from his heart, melts when he sees Suman sleeping innocently. The next day, Suman once again attempts to catch a word with Shravan, but she barely manages to speak anything. Tune into this emotional episode to find out if Suman tells Shravan what she feels for him.

videos.title: Suman Withdraws the Case
videos.overview: Suman, who is yearning to tell Shravan what she feels about him, begins to look for him at the wedding. When she spots him having a good time with Sophie, she thinks that he is still into her. Suman decides to zip up her feelings and move on in life. But when she encounters Shravan, her sentiments brim over and she tells him that she won't be taking the case against Devraj any further. This news leaves Shravan shocked. Find out if he gets to know why Suman took such a step.

videos.title: Suman's Unsaid Feelings
videos.overview: Unable to express their feelings to one another, Shravan and Suman feel stifled, and go through an emotional breakdown. When Shravan overhears Suman scolding her junior at cant with regards to the paperwork, he assumes that she doesn't want him around. But Suman leaves him stunned when she tells him that she would like it if he stayed back. Will Shravan understand Suman's unsaid feelings?

videos.title: SuVan’s Trip Down the Memory Lane
videos.overview: When Suman withdraws the case, Vikram doubts the feelings that Suman and Shravan have for each other. Parallely, Shravan gives Suman a lift on his bike. The ride makes them nostalgic and they enjoy each other's company.

videos.title: Shravan Makes a Move
videos.overview: After making up his mind that he won't hold back his emotions anymore, Shravan decides to propose to Suman. He weaves a plan and takes Veer's help in bringing Suman to their favourite spot, the SuVan corner. Meanwhile, Kanchan becomes concerned when she sees a change in Suman's behaviour. Kanchan talks to Suman and tries to make her understand that if she continues to act like this, she will end up hurting Vikram. What will Suman do? Will she and Shravan ever be together?

videos.title: Shravan to Leave Forever?
videos.overview: After Suman says yes to Vikram's proposal, Shravan is devastated. Whatever hopes he has of winning back Suman's love, shatter in an instant. But like a battle-hardened soldier, Shravan maintains his calm demeanour and doesn't disclose his feelings. He completes his final physical test and gets his report. Later, he asks Suman to sign the papers, as he wants to leave immediately. The thought of not having Shravan around breaks Suman completely. Tune in to know what happens further.

videos.title: Suman's Final Goodbye to Shravan?
videos.overview: After Shravan's tests are done, he decides to leave Bhopal and visit his parents. Suman is shocked with his sudden decision. She indirectly tries to make him stay, but her efforts fall flat, as Shravan is hell-bent on leaving. Later, when Shravan finally leaves the Tiwari House, Suman, who is on her way to the cant, recalls the sweet time spent with Shravan and gets distracted while driving. Tune in to know what unfolds further.

videos.title: Suman Contemplates Her Engagement
videos.overview: Suman has an injured ankle and is resting, but she gets flashes of her past with Shravan, of their college days. When Vikram confronts Suman about the engagement, she accepts it, but reluctantly. Later, Shravan learns about Suman's injury, but before he can react, the phone call disconnects. Will Suman and Shravan talk their mess out? Watch this highly intriguing episode to find out, only on Sony LIV.

videos.title: Suman Catches Shravan's Lie
videos.overview: Shravan returns and surprises Vikram, and upon asking, Shravan tells him that he has missed his flight. Others are also happy about this. They hope that Shravan will now stay till the engagement. But Shravan is unable to share their happiness, as he sees Suman choose Vikram's engagement ring. Once again, he breaks from the inside. Later, at night Suman visits Shravan and reveals that he was lying. As Suman probes further, what will Shravan say?

videos.title: Shravan Moves Back in His House
videos.overview: Shravan officially makes it on Suman's guest list. But his heart is unable to accept Suman marrying Vikram. Avni feels Shravan's pain and suggests him to move back in their house, as Rajendra uncle acquires it. Shravan follows his cousin's advice and informs his decision to Suman. With Suman's engagement just around the corner, will Shravan's heart let go of her? Watch Ek Duje Ke Vaaste 2 to find out.

videos.title: Suman-Shravan Share a Kiss?
videos.overview: Shravan brings Suman back into her room. While they are alone, the two are unable to resist one another, and as they are about to kiss, Chachi and Chacha come into the room. Later, Shravan opens up to Bunty, and Chachi confronts Suman, even gives her an earful about her closeness with Shravan. Even Shravan confronts Suman and asks her if she is really happy getting engaged to Vikram. What will Suman say to him?

videos.title: Suman Learns About Shravan's Feelings
videos.overview: The constant battle of emotions leaves Shravan and Suman ripped apart with their strong feelings for each other. While Suman pens down about the happy times spent with Shravan, the Malhotra boy pours out his sentiments for Suman on a piece of paper too, and later sets it on fire. Unable to see Shravan and Suman in this state, Bunty decides to take charge of the situation, and reveals Shravan's true feelings to Suman. How will Suman react to this? Tune in to know further.

videos.title: Happy Vikram, Unsure Suman
videos.overview: Finally it's the day of Suman and Vikram's engagement. While Vikram beams with happiness, Suman seems lost in Shravan's thoughts. With just a few moments away from her engagement, Suman starts wondering if she is taking the right step by choosing Vikram as her life partner. Shravan, on the other hand, refrains from attending Suman's engagement.

videos.title: Suman's Heart-Wrenching Statement
videos.overview: As Suman's engagement ceremony progresses, Avni tries her best to persuade Shravan to not attend the engagement ceremony, but Shravan doesn't listen to her and leaves anyway. By the time Shravan reaches the ceremony, Vikram is ready to put the ring on Suman's finger. It's then Bunty becomes a saviour and cuts off the electricity. Seizing on this precious chance, Shravan takes Suman to seclusion and pours his heart out, but Suman shocks him by declaring that it is too late to do anything.

videos.title: Suman Breaks Vikram's Heart?
videos.overview: Suman, unlike Vikram, isn't happy about their engagement. She gathers all her courage and calls it off at the last moment. This leaves everyone in shock. On the other hand, Shravan's father is back home, and is furious at his son for attending Suman's engagement, as well as living in their house all this while. Shravan assumes that Suman must be already engaged to Vikram. But when Vikram asks Suman her reason for breaking their engagement, she hesitates to answer him.

videos.title: United in Love, Shravan and Suman
videos.overview: Shravan, who was under the impression that Suman-Vikram are engaged, is delighted beyond measure when Suman tells him that she has called it quits with Vikram. Still in love with each other, Suman and Shravan promise to be there for one another through thick and thin. While Devraj doesn't plan on sparing the Tiwaris, Suman's chachi once again brings up the topic of selling the Tiwari house. Will Suman let her chachi take this step? Will Shravan be able to protect Suman from Devraj's intentions?

videos.title: A Drunk and Helpless Shravan
videos.overview: When Shravan learns about his father's immoral motives, he gets drunk with Bunty and opens up about his helplessness. A drunk Shravan tells Bunty that he cannot choose sides between Suman and his father, and so, he wants to go away from both of them. What will happen now? Find out in this episode.

videos.title: Shravan Buys the Tiwari House!
videos.overview: Blinded with revenge, Shravan's father decides to buy the Tiwari house. He asks Rajendra to give the token amount to Suman's uncle and complete the deal. At the same time, Kanchan asks Suman not to have faith in Shravan's love, as his family is against their happiness. But Suman ignores Kanchan's words, and puts her trust in Shravan. When Rajendra visits Suman's house to buy it, Shravan covertly manages to snatch the deal from him. Watch this exciting episode of Ek Duje Ke Vaaste 2 now.

videos.title: Vikram Leaves Bhopal Forever!
videos.overview: After Shravan buys Suman's house, she fools her family into believing that the new owner has decided to rent the Tiwari house to them. Parallelly, Shravan notices Vikram's car on the side of a road and learns that his lawyer friend is leaving Bhopal to visit his parents. But after talking to Vikram for a few minutes, Shravan assumes that Vikram has no intentions of coming back to the city. Is Shravan's assumption true? Find out in this exciting episode.

videos.title: Shravan-Suman Ki Pyaari Mulaakaat
videos.overview: Shravan is put off with his mother's reaction to things, and fears that his parents won't accept his and Suman's relationship. Suman, seeing Shravan upset, hatches a plan to brighten up his day. She sweetly comforts him on the call, and asks for a date at the chai tapri. Meanwhile, Jhumri and Dumroo keep a hawkeye on Suman and Shravan. Watch this entertaining episode to know why Jhumri and Dumroo are spying on them.

videos.title: Wedding Bells for Suman-Shravan?
videos.overview: Shravan's dad spots his bike on the road and questions him. Shravan manages to evade his dad and head to Bunty's house for invitation, along with Suman. On the other hand, while Bunty discusses wedding plans of his best buddy with Suman over the phone, Kanchan happens to hear it and is in shock. She heads to find out the truth. Watch ahead to know the rest.

videos.title: Kanchan Confronts Suman-Shravan
videos.overview: Kanchan is deeply upset with Shravan and Suman for getting married to each other. She decides to confront them without any fear. When Kanchan tells Suman that she is hurt with her decision, Shravan, like a true friend, explains the entire scenario to Kanchan, and addresses all her concerns. Elsewhere, Devraj gets his hands on the phone number of the buyer of the Tiwari House. Will Kanchan forgive Suman-Shravan? Will Devraj get through the buyer of the Tiwari House?

videos.title: Suman-Shravan in  a Fix
videos.overview: Devraj's suspicion lands on Bunty and he forces Shravan to ring him up. But thanks to Bunty's smart move, Devraj doesn't get to know about Shravan being the buyer of the Tiwari House. Later, Suman tries to speak to her chacha ji about the complicated family dynamics and her liking for Shravan, only to hear that Shravan won't be accepted in the Tiwari house. Elsewhere, Shravan's mom forbids Shravan from even thinking about Suman as a life partner. Tune in to know what the lovebirds will do now.

videos.title: Shravan's Secret Surprise
videos.overview: Shravan plans on surprising his family. He also decides to cook for them all by himself while he shares a piece of significant news. Later when Suman learns of his cooking stint, she wishes to taste the meal he made. To make her wish come true, Shravan sends Jhumri di over to the Tiwari house with the tiffin. What's Shravan's surprise about? And will Suman get to taste the food he made after all? Watch this exciting episode to know what happens further.

videos.title: Shravan-Suman's Sweet Love
videos.overview: On learning that Suman has lied to him and not eaten the meal, Shravan gets really annoyed with Suman and gets into an argument with her. Suman tries to explain Shravan her reasons, but to no avail. Later, when Suman gets to know that Shravan has not eaten food as well, she plans a sweet surprise for him. Meanwhile, Shravan's chachi tells the whole Malhotra family that she wants Rajendra to sign the divorce papers. Watch what plan Suman and Shravan come up with to tackle this situation.

videos.title: Shravan's Flight
videos.overview: While travelling to the airport, Shravan's father talks to him about the marriage proposals that his mother is getting for him. Shravan suspects that his father knows about him and Suman. Meanwhile, Suman comes to the airport to surprise Shravan before he leaves.

videos.title: Suman's Special Dish
videos.overview: Suman prepares a special 'Gajar ka halwa' from her father's secret recipe. However, her aunt has still not made peace with her and Shravan's relationship and is upset that Suman hid this truth from her.

videos.title: Shravan Parties at the Camp
videos.overview: Shravan arrives at the army camp and introduces Suman to his friends. Meanwhile, Rajendra is worried about Devraj's reaction, when he hears about Suman and Shravan's relationship.

videos.title: Shravan and Suman's Wedding
videos.overview: A blast happens near Shravan's campsite. Shravan goes with a search party to investigate. Meanwhile, Bunty and Kanchan are busy preparing for Shravan and Suman's wedding.

videos.title: Where Is Shravan?
videos.overview: Suman is getting ready for her wedding day. Meanwhile, Suman and Shravan's families arrive at the marriage registrar office. However, Shravan is nowhere to be found.

videos.title: Shravan's Choice
videos.overview: Shravan has still not reached the marriage registrar's office. Devraj believes that Shravan chose his family over Suman. Later on, an army vehicle arrives at the gate of the Malhotra house. What has happened to Shravan?

videos.title: Malhotras and Tiwaris Get Closer
videos.overview: Suman is completely distraught upon learning that Shravan is Missing. However, this difficult situation brings the Malhotras and the Tiwaris closer than ever before.

videos.title: Suman - A Courageous Daughter
videos.overview: Suman vows to Shravan's mother, that if he returns, she will forever distance herself from him and not pursue him for marriage. The next day Suman gets ready for her duty and is determined to make Shravan and her father feel proud.

videos.title: Suman's Promise
videos.overview: Shravan has returned home safely, but he suspects that Suman is hiding something from him. He barges into her room at night, looking for answers. Will Suman reveal the promise she made to Shravan's mother?

videos.title: Suman's Family Is Convinced
videos.overview: Suman is excited to tell Shravan that her aunt and uncle have agreed to their marriage. Although, Shravan's family has still not agreed to it. Suman is hopeful that together, they will be able to convince them.

videos.title: Shravan Ka Sagan
videos.overview: The Malhotra's get ready to bring gifts to the Tiwari's in celebration of Shravan and Suman's marriage getting confirmed. The two lovers are also excited, as all the obstacles in their path have been removed, and they finally get to be together in matrimony.

videos.title: Shravan and Suman's Badminton Practice
videos.overview: Shravan helps Suman with her training for the Inter Regiment Badminton Championship. Meanwhile, Shravan's family is preparing for their son's lavish wedding.

videos.title: Major Suman Tiwari
videos.overview: Another cause of celebration has been added to the list, with Suman being promoted to the rank of Major. Shravan throws a grand party upon hearing this good news, meanwhile awaiting his own promotion as well.

videos.title: Shravan's Last Kept Secret
videos.overview: The fact that Shravan bought a house under Suman's name has finally come to light. What complications will this new problem cause between the two families?

videos.title: Shravan Ki Mehendi Ka Rang
videos.overview: Shravan gets angry at Suman when she ignores his affectionate advances. Meanwhile, Malhotras and Tiwaris celebrate the Mehendi function in a grandiose manner.

videos.title: Suman's Prank Backfires
videos.overview: Kanchan and Suman play a prank on Shravan, but it doesn't seem to go down well with Shravan's mother. Will this small moment of fun, cause big problems for the two lovers?

videos.title: Beena vs Kavita
videos.overview: Beena gets upset when she finds out that a Malhotra family member had come to the 'Puja', drunk. Meanwhile, things get worse between Kavita and Beena, just before the wedding ceremony begins.

videos.title: Shravan Ki Baaraat
videos.overview: Suman and Shravan's wedding celebrations are underway in full swing. However, there are bound to be some complications when Beena sees Shravan's wedding outfit. But will SuVan's love be able to overcome this obstacle?

videos.title: Shaadi Ki Shuruaat
videos.overview: The power goes out at the wedding, which leaves a bad impression in the minds of the Malhotras. Despite that, the wedding ceremony finally begins, and Shravan and Suman take their 'Saat Phere' together.

videos.title: Shravan Ki Duty
videos.overview: The wedding ceremony is over, and Suman is happily welcomed into her new home. The newly married couple are finally together after all the hurdles. However, Shravan's army duty causes a rift in their newfound happiness.

videos.title: Shravan Prepares Suman
videos.overview: Shravan is preparing Suman for the badminton match, but Suman is not taking interest. Shravan is very keen for Suman to win the match but Suman is upset as Shravan will not be there to witness the match.

videos.title: Major Shravan Malhotra
videos.overview: Shravan is conflicted about his new promotion. Meanwhile, Suman has to go for a picnic with her peers. Will Shravan tell Suman the truth about his posting?

videos.title: Shravan Aur Suman Ki Perfect Partnership
videos.overview: Suman wants to leave the picnic and go home. But, Shravan arrives there and surprises her. Later, Shravan and Suman help rescue a few people from a sinking boat and are regarded as true heroes by everyone.

videos.title: Suman's Promotion
videos.overview: Shravan is upset about his promotion which has kept him stationed at Bhopal, away from all the action. Meanwhile, Suman's new position as the Unit In-Charge leaves him even more conflicted about his career.

videos.title: Shravan Reporting for Duty
videos.overview: Suman is worried about Shravan's mood after returning from the event. Kanchan invites Bunty for dinner at her house. Meanwhile, Shravan's CO has assigned him an immoral task. What will he do?

videos.title: Shravan - A Smart Officer
videos.overview: Shravan is upset about not getting enough credit for his heroic act at the lake. Shravan brings a special gift for Suman in celebration of her promotion. Meanwhile, Bunty and Kanchan go on a date together.

videos.title: Surprise Party for Beena
videos.overview: Suman is planning a surprise party for her Chachi. Shravan is facing problems with his CO. Meanwhile, Kanchan asks Bunty to take care of the catering. What will happen at the party?

videos.title: Suman's Breakfast Plans
videos.overview: Suman is getting late for Beena's birthday party. Shravan is upset at Suman for putting work before family. Suman prepares a special breakfast to make it up to Shravan, but Shravan leaves home early for duty. What will happen now?

videos.title: Shravan's Request
videos.overview: Shravan makes a problematic request to Suman on his CO's behalf. Kanchan and Bunty go to a cafe, but Kanchan is unaware that it's a date. Will Suman come through on Shravan's request?

videos.title: Avani's Reasons
videos.overview: Talks have started at the Malhotra household for Avani's marriage. However, Avani has no intention of getting married. Meanwhile, Kanchan and Bunty continue to grow close to each other. Will Suman help Avani with her marriage problem?

videos.title: Haar Jeet Ki Baat
videos.overview: Shravan acknowledges that what he asked Suman to do was wrong and rushes to stop her before it's too late. Meanwhile, Kanchan gets mad at Bunty for not showing up for their date on time. Keep watching the show to find out more.

videos.title: Suman's Valentine's Surprise
videos.overview: Suman has planned a valentine's surprise for Shravan. However, she herself gets surprised when she sees a puja happening in the house. What will happen if Suman's family members find the surprise hamper?

videos.title: Bunty Ka Cake
videos.overview: Shravan's parents find the hamper Suman ordered for him. Kanchan is upset with Bunty for ditching her at the cafe. Meanwhile, Shravan and Suman finally get to spend their Valentine's together.

videos.title: Suman's New Chair
videos.overview: Shravan gifts Suman a new chair so that she can write comfortably while sitting on it. Suman and Shravan decide to redecorate their terrace together. Meanwhile, Beena calls up Bunty to get her electricity bill sorted.

videos.title: Kanchan Apologizes
videos.overview: Suman and Shravan argue about which carpet to buy but eventually, their conversation steers towards Avni, who they feel is hiding something. Later, Kanchan gets a cake for Bunty as an apology.

videos.title: SuVan Pad
videos.overview: Shravan and Suman are out furniture shopping for their room. Kanchan gets mad at Bunty for scolding her. Now both Kanchan and Bunty seek Shravan and Suman's advice, in hopes of making things right. What will happen next?

videos.title: Shravan Confronts Avani
videos.overview: Suman tells Shravan about Avani's reasons for not marrying. Kanchan is upset with Bunty and does not pick up his calls. SuVan Pad's redecoration is still underway. Meanwhile, Shravan confronts Avani about the boy she loves.

videos.title: Shravan's Bet
videos.overview: Shravan makes a bet with Suman that he will win the badminton championship against her regiment. Beena finds the letter Bunty threw at Kanchan's window. Meanwhile, Avani's boyfriend comes to her house to meet the Malhotra family.

videos.title: Oversmart Kanchan
videos.overview: Shravan is training hard for the badminton championship. Kanchan tries to control the situation by talking to Beena. Meanwhile, Shravan gets disheartened after losing a badminton match. What will happen next?

videos.title: Forever Wala Love Day
videos.overview: Shravan plans a surprise for Suman, along with Avani's help. Beena has invited Kanchan's friend, Dolly, over for lunch. Meanwhile, Bunty comes up with a plan to help Kanchan with her problem. What will happen next?

videos.title: Suman Is Injured
videos.overview: Suman's ankle gets sprained and now she cannot compete in the badminton competition. Meanwhile, Bunty is upset after he receives the news of his ex's marriage. What will happen next?

videos.title: Badminton Championship Begins
videos.overview: Despite having an injured leg, Suman stands her ground in the badminton championship. Shravan tries his best to boost her morale. Meanwhile, Avani is worried that her family will find out about her relationship. What will happen next?

videos.title: Kanchan Ki Pasand
videos.overview: After winning her first match, Suman returns home to rest. Shravan is also performing well in his matches. Meanwhile, Suman asks Kanchan about Bunty. Keep watching to find out more.

videos.title: Kanchan's Feelings for Bunty
videos.overview: Kanchan realizes her feelings for Bunty. Shravan is conflicted about the badminton championship and all the praise that Suman is collecting. Watch the episode to find out more.

videos.title: Kanchan's Fashion Tips
videos.overview: Suman's health is deteriorating by the minute. However, Suman doesn't want to worry Shravan about anything. Kanchan gives Bunty some fashion tips so that he can look good infront of his colleagues. Meanwhile, Avani and Ayan start taking the first steps of their new venture.

videos.title: Shravan vs Major Rounak
videos.overview: Shravan gets scolded by his CO for not keeping his head in the game. He competes against Major Rounak in his next match. Suman figures out a way to watch Shravan's match while resting at home.

videos.title: Avani's Date Night
videos.overview: Shravan and Suman think about what to do with the Maldives trip that they won. Avani and Ayaan decide to go on a date together. Will Avani's family allow her?

videos.title: Organized Miya-Biwi
videos.overview: Shravan finds out some troubling news about Avani. He rushes home and wants to speak to Avani and Ayaan in private. Meanwhile, Kanchan starts feeling jealous after hearing Bunty's story.

videos.title: Shravan Ka Gussa
videos.overview: Shravan finds out that the bike race was Ayaan's idea. Now Shravan thinks that Ayaan is not suitable for his sister, Avani. Meanwhile, Kanchan seeks Bunty's help to fix the plumbing at her home.

videos.title: Shravan's Apology
videos.overview: Shravan apologizes to Suman for his rude behaviour. Avani still has a sour mood about what Shravan did to Ayaan. Meanwhile, Kanchan is excited to meet Bunty and wants to look her best.

videos.title: Bunty Ka Birthday
videos.overview: Ayaan barges into the Malhotra house and declares his love for Avani. Meanwhile, Bunty wants to confess his love for Kanchan as soon as possible. Will he be able to do it?

videos.title: Bunty Ki Surprise Party
videos.overview: Shravan and Suman decide to throw a surprise party for Bunty on his birthday. Meanwhile, Kanchan plans a different surprise for him. Will Bunty and Kanchan's relationship come out infront of everyone?

videos.title: Reason to Celebrate
videos.overview: Suman calls Kanchan to invite her to the surprise party, but Bunty picks up. He is happy to find out that Shravan has planned the party for him. What will happen once he reaches there?

videos.title: Bunty and Kanchan Finally Together
videos.overview: After the surprise party, Bunty and Kanchan finally get a chance to express their love for one another. However, Shravan and Suman overhear their conversation and find out about their chemistry. How will the two of them react?

videos.title: Suman's Approval
videos.overview: Shravan calls Ayaan's parents home to begin discussions about his and Avani's wedding. After hearing that Kanchan and Bunty are together, Suman is unable to accept it and argues with Shravan. Will Suman give her approval?

videos.title: Hamari Vaali Date
videos.overview: Shravan's family takes up the task of talking to Kanchan's parents about her and Bunty's marriage. Meanwhile, Shravan and Suman decide to spend time together by recreating one of their first dates.

videos.title: Pyaar Ya Ego
videos.overview: Kanchan's parents are not convinced about her and Bunty's marriage. This causes a major rift in Suman and Shravan's relationship. Meanwhile, Kanchan tries her best to convince her mother.

videos.title: Shravan and Suman on a Break
videos.overview: Shravan and Suman's constant arguments and bickering have forced them to take a break from their relationship. In anger, Shravan texts Suman an inappropriate message and is worried that she might read it.

videos.title: Pehle Vaala Trust
videos.overview: Shravan and Suman seem to grow apart, but they still miss each other. Suman has shifted back to her house and doesn't feel like going back to Shravan's house. Will Shravan be able to bring Suman back into his life?

videos.title: New Entry in Suman's Diary
videos.overview: Suman is heartbroken as she feels she is drifting apart from the love of her life, Shravan. Bunty and Kanchan try their best to cheer up their mood and resolve the issue.

videos.title: Shravan's Guilt
videos.overview: Shravan and Suman think about how the differences between them are constantly growing. Shravan has taken a holiday from duty in order to help with Avani's wedding arrangements.

videos.title: Ghar Jaisi Feeling
videos.overview: Suman is back in the house to help with Avani's wedding preparations. However, she still feels uncomfortable, standing in the room as Shravan. Meanwhile, Bunty calls Kanchan for an emergency meeting.

videos.title: Bunty's Home Loan
videos.overview: Shravan and his family are busy preparing for Avani's wedding. Kanchan is upset because Bunty's application for a home loan gets rejected. Meanwhile, will the differences between Shravan and Suman continue to grow?

videos.title: Reunion Party
videos.overview: Suman and Shravan let go of their differences and prepare for Avani's wedding. Shravan informs Suman about their college reunion.
